menu.shadowDailyOfficialDescription: Download and browse official seed dates. Uses a cached or built-in archive if download fails.
menu.shadowDailyOfflineDescription: Play today's shared offline run. The same game version and UTC date use the same seed.
menu.shadowDailyOfflineMenuHelp: Choose which calendar date to use for Offline Daily Run.
menu.shadowDailyOfflineTodayDescription: Use today's existing Offline Daily seed.
menu.shadowDailyOfflineYesterdayDescription: Use the previous local calendar date.
menu.shadowDailyOfflineChooseDateDescription: Choose any date from 1900 through today.
menu.shadowDailyOfflineYearHelp: Choose a year. Left and Right move by ten years.
menu.shadowDailyRandomDescription: Choose a seeded Random Run lasting 5, 10, 20, 30, 50, or 100 waves.
menu.shadowDailyBossRushDescription: Battle 10 powerful bosses with a random team of three level 100 Pokémon.
menu.shadowDailyCustomDescription: Reuse a previous seed or create a repeatable run from memorable text.

menu.shadowDailyTextDescription: Enter any memorable text. The same text will always create the same 50-wave run.
menu.shadowDailyRandomConfirm: Generate a new random {{waves}}-wave Daily Run?
menu.shadowDailyRandomVariantHelp: Choose the total number of waves.

menu.shadowDailyBossRushHardDescription: Carry HP, PP, fainting, and major status into the next boss.
